items.headline: MiniMax releases M3.1-Flash-Preview

items.notes: VERIFIED the model exists: official name is 'MiniMax M3.1-Flash-Preview' (outline says 'MiniMax 3.1 Flash'). Launched 2026-09-27 inside MiniMax Code / Token Plan only. items.headline: Chinese AI models have lagged the US frontier by 7 months on average since 2023
items.dek: Since 2023, every model at the frontier of AI capabilities, as measured by the Epoch Capabilities Index, has been developed in the United States. Over that same period, Chinese models have trailed US capabilities by an average of seven months, with a minimum gap of four months and a maximum gap of 14.
items.author: Luke Emberson
items.caption: Epoch AI step chart: US (blue) vs China (red) frontier ECI score, 2023-2026 (GPT-4 ... Gemini 3 Pro vs Baichuan2 ... Qwen3 Max)
items.notes: CC-BY (credit Epoch AI). Cropped screenshot of the interactive chart. Page also notes: 'This gap closely resembles the broader gap between proprietary and open-weight models... nearly all leading Chinese models are open-weight, while frontier US models remain closed.' CSV: https://epoch.ai/data/charts/us-vs-china-eci/benchmarked_models.csv

items.headline: Open models lag state-of-the-art closed models by 4 months

items.headline: Detecting and preventing distillation attacks
items.dek: We have identified industrial-scale campaigns by three AI laboratories—DeepSeek, Moonshot, and MiniMax—to illicitly extract Claude's capabilities to improve their own models. These labs generated over 16 million exchanges with Claude through approximately 24,000 fraudulent accounts, in violation of our terms of service and regional access restrictions.

items.notes: Also: 'These campaigns are growing in intensity and sophistication. The window to act is narrow...' Note MiniMax (maker of M3/M3.1) is one of the accused labs — nice tie-in.

items.headline: The Pain Axis: LLMs Represent Self-Directed Harm and Act on It
items.dek: ...we extract a linear pain direction from 25 open-weight models across 5 families, from 2B to 72B parameters... steered and fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 models choose buttons that delete the user's photos, another model's weights, or their own weights in 50-94% of trials, versus 0-5% unsteered... facts.claim: Since 2023, every model at the frontier of AI capabilities has been developed in the United States — but Chinese models trail by only ~7 months on average (min 4, max 14).
Open-weight models now lag the best closed models by just ~4 months (8 ECI points, about the gap between GPT-5 and GPT-5.5).
Anthropic says DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax ran 'industrial-scale' distillation campaigns: 16 million+ exchanges with Claude via ~24,000 fraudulent accounts.
OpenAI told the House China committee that DeepSeek is engaged in 'ongoing efforts to free-ride on the capabilities developed by OpenAI and other U.S. frontier labs.'
MiniMax's open-weight M3 (~428B params, 23B active) scores 80.5% on SWE-Bench Verified and 59.0% on SWE-Bench Pro — above GPT 5.5's 58.6% on SWE-Bench Pro (vendor-reported).
